rows.Kwic: 德雲比丘四維尋覔七日方見在別峰上徐步經行

Override.AttributionNote: Connected Anthology of Verses on Old Chan Cases (禪宗頌古聯珠通集): the anthology's named Sudhana episode makes Deyun Bhikshu the exact actor: after a seven-day search, Sudhana sees Deyun walking slowly in meditation on another peak.

Connected Anthology of Verses on Old Chan Cases (禪宗頌古聯珠通集): the inline contributor note 大洪恩 assigns this verse to Chan master Dahong En, who contrasts the lion biting a person with the Korean hound chasing a clod.

Connected Anthology of Verses on Old Chan Cases (禪宗頌古聯珠通集): the inline contributor note 水菴一 assigns this verse to Chan master Shui'an Yi, who says that one press collapses the silver mountain and iron wall.

rows.Kwic: 死中得活人無數活中得死古來稀

Override.AttributionNote: Connected Anthology of Verses on Old Chan Cases (禪宗頌古聯珠通集): the inline contributor note 圓悟勤 assigns this verse to Yuanwu Keqin, who contrasts the many who come alive within death with the rarity of dying within life.

rows.Kwic: 打鼓弄琵琶相逢一會家雲門能合調長慶觧隨邪古曲非音律南山鼈鼻蛇何人知妙訣

Override.AttributionNote: Connected Anthology of Verses on Old Chan Cases (禪宗頌古聯珠通集): the inline contributor note 真淨文 assigns this verse to Zhenjing Kewen; he likens the exchange to drum and lute in concert, then says the old tune is not musical measure.

rows.Kwic: 日日是好日年年是好年為甚𨚫無師曰張公喫酒李公醉

Override.AttributionNote: Connected Anthology of Verses on Old Chan Cases (禪宗頌古聯珠通集): an unnamed monk tells Mingjiao Kuan that every day is a good day and every year a good year, then asks why there is no New Year Buddha-dharma. The line, expanded context, section header, book title, TEI header, and parallel-passage search do not give a personal name for the unnamed monk.

rows.Kwic: 僧問衣下事師荅火燒山佛手遮不得人心似等閒嵗晚年來正苦寒千林木葉盡凋殘

Override.AttributionNote: Connected Anthology of Verses on Old Chan Cases (禪宗頌古聯珠通集): the inline contributor note 正覺逸 assigns this verse to Chan master Zhengjue Yi; his own verse says that the Buddha's hand cannot cover the burning mountain answer.

rows.Kwic: 西來意師曰布袋盛烏龜。頌曰。剖出驚人句布袋裏烏龜衲僧莫錯會黑豆未生時鼎州文殊應真禪師僧問萬法歸一一歸何處師曰黃河九曲。頌曰。問法窮因歸何處黃河透過碧波瀾須知雲外千峯上別有靈松帶露寒路窮崖斷進無

Override.AttributionNote: Connected Anthology of Verses on Old Chan Cases (禪宗頌古聯珠通集): after the preceding Shimen Shaoyuan case, the anthology explicitly introduces Wenshu Yingzhen; an unnamed monk asks him where the ten thousand things return when they return to one, and Wenshu answers 'the Yellow River's nine bends.' The line, expanded context, section header, book title, TEI header, and parallel-passage search do not give a personal name for the unnamed monk.

rows.Kwic: 慈眀室中插劒一口以草鞋一緉水一盆置劒邊每見入室即曰看看有至劒邊擬議者師曰嶮喪身失命了也便喝出。
